label: Diagram 16
caption: Diagram 16 Lateral support at roof level
description: Diagram 16, titled Lateral support at roof level, carries the note See para 2C36 at top left and is divided into four isometric views. a, Tension strap location, shows a gable end wall supporting a pitched roof, with tension straps at not more than 2m centres (see (b)) and a tension strap at highest point that will provide a secure connection. Dimensions shown are t = sum of thicknesses of leaves + 10mm, h, x, and x/2 twice, alongside the text If h is greater than 16 t, provide restraint here at not greater than 2m centres. b, Effective strapping at gable wall, shows a pack, a strap turned over uncut block, and nogging. c, Vertical strapping at eaves – flat roofs, shows each joist fixed to wall-plate with framing anchors or skew nails, and a strap anchored to wall and turned over wall-plate. d, Vertical strapping at eaves – pitched roofs, shows a rafter fixed to wall-plate with framing anchor or truss clip, and a strap anchored to wall and rafter.
